metadata.description: Mods that enforce and route the coordinator skills of this repository.

plugins.name: model-guard
plugins.description: Enforces model-mix on delegated launches: Sonnet for unpinned agents, no haiku alias, Fable kept off background work, workflow width capped by today's profile, no new launches on a red budget or a paused 5-hour window.

plugins.name: skill-router
plugins.description: Smart activation of skills with no model cost: suggests the skill a message calls for and asks for model-mix and smart-ultracode before the first workflow.
